scope: Board memory completion; only synthetic local fixtures used

interfaces.history_with_status: Same kwargs as history; returns items/status from one scoped SQLite snapshot; boundary_incomplete, boundary_omitted_summaries, matching_count, returned_count, result_limited, summary_details_recoverable=false, absence_proven=false
interfaces.context_source_id: Optional context(scope,context_source_id=...) filters recent turns before LIMIT and only wholly belonging continuity summaries; facts and explicit history remain scoped normally
interfaces.profile_catalogue: create_profile(name,consent=True)->id; profiles()->[{id,name}]; require_profile(id)->None; no grant issuance
interfaces.data_origin: synthetic default or explicit board; cross-origin open rejected without mutation; constructor starts no worker/import/cleanup
interfaces.migration: source_data_origin must match explicit target origin; old SHA/schema/provenance/quiescent/empty-target gates remain; minimal profile id/name/created retained only in local private target; report excludes catalogue values
interfaces.worker: Board origin requires explicit compaction_guard_factory; prepared.keepalive callback renews only live unchanged leases between model calls, under short quality-guard transaction

multipart_summary.authority: Exact original refs/revisions/claims and frozen body hashes remain board-owned; full atomic publish/readback before covered body removal
multipart_summary.source_coverage: Every eligible original text fragment sent once using request-local alias/character offset; protected numbers/names/recognized negation phrases not cut; all critical metadata sent as bounded records
multipart_summary.failure: Any failure/cancel/stale clock/source keeps all original bodies; irreducible protected source retries fairly without starving unrelated closed groups

remaining_limits: Mechanical coverage and critical-field guards cannot prove semantic losslessness.
Indivisible protected tokens or critical summaries exceeding bounded storage/work remain detailed backlog; no truncation/deletion.
A large published summary may not fit one dialogue context; parent context builder must expose omitted items instead of inventing missing detail.
Legacy imported turns currently retain legacy provenance but not new context_source_id markers; explicit history and long-term facts remain available, new writes use the new conversation marker.
Real ARM clock/load/player/production migration and cutover remain parent-owned gates.
